headline: Apple to hold second October product event on the 28th
summary: Apple has invited press to a second product event this month, set for October 28th in Los Angeles. One report expects new Macs, including a MacBook Pro and refreshed iPad Mini, citing Bloomberg; another expects the event, reportedly called 'Pro and Tell,' to feature the first touchscreen Mac.

claims.statement: Apple will hold a second product event this month, on October 28th in Los Angeles.

sources.quote: Apple has sent invites to a second product launch this month, and it's scheduled for October 28th at 1PM ET in Los Angeles.
Apple is set to hold another product event on October 28

claims.statement: The Verge, citing Bloomberg, expects Apple to announce new Macs and a refreshed iPad Mini at the event.

sources.quote: Apple is set to announce new Macs and a refreshed iPad Mini, according to Bloomberg

claims.statement: Engadget reports the event is called 'Pro and Tell' and will likely feature the first touchscreen Mac.

sources.quote: Apple's "Pro and Tell" event is taking place in Los Angeles and will likely feature the first touchscreen Mac.

discrepancies.explanation: The Verge's reporting centers on an expected MacBook Pro and iPad Mini while Engadget's centers on an expected touchscreen Mac; neither mentions the other's specific prediction.
